notes.title: Devlog #19 - Lore, Voices of the Void & The King!
notes.content:
[h3]Greetings, Void Hunters![/h3][p][/p][p]The Void echoes as we unveil [b]major additions to the game[/b] in Devlog #19! Coming with the full release, we're adding a new experience to the game that introduces the world and the plot of the game, along with new life into every void hunter with [b]all-new voice acting[/b], and unleashing our most terrifying foe yet: [b]The Void King[/b]. Sharpen your blades and ready your ears—let's dive in![/p][p][/p][h2]Through the darkness, we rise![/h2][p][b]First steps matter.[/b][/p][p]We've transformed the early game with a brand new introduction chapter, that starts within the [b]Void Hunters' Stronghold[/b] — a living, breathing introduction to our world. You will find out what the Void Hunters seek to accomplish and how all the parts of the game finally fit together into one campaign.  [/p][previewyoutube="srOZuiB29kc;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]You will learn more about the Void Hunters, their Stronghold and what they seek to achieve, in order to [b]protect the Dawnstone, the light that must never fade.[/b] [/p][previewyoutube="q7N6gBXFzZ4;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]As the game unfolds and you unlock new characters, you will learn more about the world, their mission and the personality of each Void Hunter, [b]with over 2500 new voice lines[/b] spread across the game. [/p][previewyoutube="CKuSA3yOwiQ;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]With the release update, [b]part 2 of the Titan Hunt is now in place[/b], and you will finally learn what Titan Blood can be used for. Be ready to face off against [b]7 new bosses[/b], and prepare yourself, [b]for the Void King awaits![/b][/p][previewyoutube="H741lTWLrMk;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h2]Voices of the Void: Hunters Find Their Voice[/h2][p][b]Hear them roar, whisper, and taunt![/b]

As you might have heard from the Void Hunter’s Stronghold, every character now has their own [b]unique voice lines[/b], from battle cries to past laments. We collaborated with [b]12 incredible voice actors[/b] to capture each void hunter’s essence.[/p][previewyoutube="2IVhNesZ9uk;full"][/previewyoutube][p]This is something we always wanted to add to the game, and while it took months of planning and writing and reviewing… hearing the characters in-game for the first time felt like magic to us, and we can only hope you will enjoy it as much as we do![/p][p][/p][h2]Brand new soundtracks[/h2][p]With everything that is coming to the game with the full release, we obviously needed [b]new epic music[/b] to accompany it. Gama, our sound designer has been hard at work tinkering with a brand new OST for it. Have a listen at [b]the vibe he’s going for:[/b] [/p][previewyoutube="e7mExbLeLFA;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h2]Closing Thoughts: The Calm Before the Storm[/h2][p]These additions finally lay the last pieces of the foundation for [b]1.0's imminent launch[/b]. It has truly been an incredible journey so far. The game has changed so much since its first playable version that it feels a bit crazy, and we are preparing a [b]little bit of a nostalgia trip to show you just how much the game has changed over time![/b] So stay tunned to our socials for that!

Also important to note that version [b]1.0 is not the end for Soulstone Survivors.[/b] We truly want to continue working on the game for as long as we possibly can and this is made possible by [b]YOUR[/b] continued love and support, so a most heartfelt [b]THANK YOU![/b]

Farewell, for now... Good luck out there, void hunters.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42629950/0613ae8b16cc071c726ac24a6c6e0f9156b2c8a2.gif"][/img][/p][p]
[i][b]~ The Soulstone Team[/b][/i][/p]

notes.title: Devlog #18 - The Samurai Rises: A Community's Legacy & New Artifact Powers
notes.content: [h1]Greetings, Void Hunters![/h1][p][/p][p]Three years ago, [b]you spoke—and the Void listened.[/b] Devlog #18 unveils [b]one of the two[/b] new characters coming with the full release. This is a very special one, as it was chosen by [i]you[/i], the community, in one of our Discord community events, as [b]the most voted character[/b] to join the ranks of the Void Hunters… [b]The Samurai![/b][/p][p][/p][p]Alongside this long-awaited Void Hunter, you will also gain access to ALL remaining Artifact Powers for all weapons and characters, and today we will show you a little glimpse of a couple new ones you can expect! Let’s dive in![/p][p][/p][h3]The Samurai: Forged by the Community[/h3][p][b]This one’s for YOU.[/b][/p][p][/p][p]Back in 2022, hundreds of you voted to bring this disciplined warrior into our world—a tribute to the passion that shapes [i]Soulstone Survivors.[/i] While it’s been a while since we last had one of these community events, the Samurai stands as a [b]timeless testament to your voice.[/b] Sharp, swift, fiery and sometimes ghostly, he’s finally unsheathing his katanas![/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="Ih3Jl10oyDA;full"][/previewyoutube][h3]New Skills and Trait: A master of blades[/h3][p]As usual, The Samurai is also coming with 3 new character specific skills and 8 brand new weapon skills. His playstyle resolves around slicing, cutting, stabbing and sometimes cursing his enemies with a new negative effect, [b]Condemned,[/b] which is consumed by critical strikes to [b]drastically amplify the damage caused![/b][/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="Wj_ybU1Dmww;full"][/previewyoutube][h3]Ascension: Cursed Shrine[/h3][p]We have envisioned the Samurai as a character that is both very good with blades but also spiritual, maintaining a certain connection to the ghostly realms of the occult, being able to tap into the manifestation of his own rage spirit to fight for him. Check it out![/p][p][/p][p][b]Cursed Shrine in action[/b][/p][previewyoutube="sAt8FMF4HgE;full"][/previewyoutube][h3]New Artifact Powers highlight: Death Knight & Engineer[/h3][p]The release update will bring a ton of new content to the game, including all remaining Artifact Powers for all characters and weapons in the game! So today we wanted to show you a couple of cool new artifact powers you can expect to see soon.[/p][p][/p][p]First, a little glimpse at the Death Knight’s Dragonflight, calling in an ancient bone dragon to lay waste to enemies in a line, leaving a powerful damaging area in its wake:[/p][previewyoutube="3A7-UAN-SPk;full"][/previewyoutube][p]The Engineer is also joining the party, with his new Plasma Sentry, which pours flame into nearby enemies causing massive damage and debuffing them with different effects:[/p][previewyoutube="wav4DJQe59I;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Can you guess what the Artifact Powers will be for the other remaining characters??[/p][p][/p][h3]Closing Thoughts: Legacy & Future[/h3][p]The Samurai is more than a character—he’s a [b]monument to your impact[/b] on this journey. Though community votes are paused, your feedback [i]still[/i] guides us daily. The Samurai is cool and all but who do you think this other shadowy figure could be?…[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="ZsFJqOTNHoc;full"][/previewyoutube][p]There is still a lot we haven't talked about coming to the game, and if you are curious… you might want to follow the game to check out our devlog next week… we will show [b]another little sneak peek of something pretty cool we have been working on for months![/b] As always thank you for your amazing support and we hope you are excited as we are for the full release![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42629950/0613ae8b16cc071c726ac24a6c6e0f9156b2c8a2.gif"][/img][/p][p][b]~ The Soulstone Team[/b][/p]

notes.title: Devlog #17 - Crafting the New Key Art – Sketches, Stories & Soulstones
notes.content:
[h1]Greetings, Void Hunters![/h1]

We’re thrilled to pull back the curtain and show you [b]how our new Key Art came to life[/b]—from early concepts to the [b]final result![/b] We asked Raphael Massarani, the amazing artist behind the scenes (check out his [url=(https://www.artstation.com/rmassarani)]artstation here[/url], its incredible) to share how he approached the creation of this image, so grab a coffee, and let’s dive into the creative journey with the artist’s own words!

[h3]Phase 1: The Birth of Three Concepts[/h3]

[b]To get started, Raphael explains:[/b]
“[i]I usually begin by working on sketches that closely reflect my intentions for the final composition, story, and overall lighting. Sketch A features a heroic Pyromancer holding a Soulstone, confident in her victory as she blasts her enemies away. Sketch B showcases different Void Hunters, alluding to the game’s massive roster of playable characters and intense combat! Sketch C features Arcane Weaver on her journey to face a menacing challenge head-on—a boss rush, if you will.[/i]”

[b]KeyArt_SketchA.jpg[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42629950/d77f580eb3181ab201d783464ca96bf6dadfaddf.jpg[/img]
[b]KeyArt_SketchB.jpg[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42629950/cac888a616a53e29db952794b6d0c2cd17695f7b.jpg[/img]
[b]KeyArt_SketchC.jpg[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42629950/1bb5892e17947cd4f3ae21d6db803e29afe95794.jpg[/img]
“[i]As you can see, I sometimes like to contain the focal point of my images within a simple geometric shape. This helps me guide the viewer’s eyes and keep the story engaging.[/i]”

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42629950/9c7a19d30b614b1e3e819a5cb227e498a14ab13f.jpg[/img]
[h3]Phase 2: Exploration and Refinements[/h3]

[b]On early experiments:[/b]
“[i]We gave Sketch C a go first, posing Arcane Weaver facing toward us and adding secondary enemies alongside the bosses. While it could’ve been interesting, it felt too busy for a Key Art.[/i]”

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42629950/d2e0239843e75727f6c13df2aebaf977bf6289c8.jpg[/img]
“[i]Back to the drawing board! Sketch A had great qualities, so I revamped it with a new composition and a second pass featuring the Arcane Weaver. The new version looked cool, but it leaned too close to ‘splash art.’ Ultimately, we chose version B—as it nailed the chaotic energy of the game.[/i]”

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42629950/f3335d73e9d45a412e40eeb42d95e12a40e756cc.jpg[/img]
[h3]Phase 3: The Color Crucible[/h3]

[b]On finding the perfect palette:[/b]

“[i]Again we started experimenting with a few color options. Option E felt right—it complements Arcane Weaver’s spells, her color scheme, and the Soulstones’ role in the story.[/i]”

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42629950/f840eb153fddb5dcf39eb8123cfdb46e35612a8a.jpg[/img]
[h3]Phase 4: The Final Polish[/h3]

[b]On refinement:[/b]

“[i]Once composition, lighting, and colors were locked, it was time to refine, adjust, tweak, and polish. It’s my comfort zone, but it still takes ages![/i]”

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42629950/365840486a869ef72cede46c1b8e70d71d9233fb.gif[/img]
[h3]Closing Thoughts from the Artist[/h3]

“[i]Hope you love the new Key Art as much as I enjoyed working on it! Thanks to Game Smithing for the awesome opportunity :D[/i]”

We hope you found his process as interesting as we did, and while we have been a bit quiet over the last few weeks, keep an eye out as there are a few spicy sneak peeks coming soon… for example… where do you think this door leads to?? Let us know in the comments!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42629950/ab41e06f52603366bdd829998942b538b1b46df5.png[/img]
[b][i]~ The Soulstone Survivors Team[/i][/b]

notes.title: The Titan Hunt - Hotfix 1 & 2
New Update: The Titan Hunt
notes.content:
[h3]Greetings, Void Hunters![/h3]

Today is a very special day, [b]a huge milestone for Soulstone Survivors![/b] We are releasing the [b]largest update the game has ever seen[/b], along with the [b]full release announcement[/b], [b]key art updates[/b], [b]supporter pack DLC[/b]… there is so much to cover, so let’s get started!

[h2]Soulstone Survivors 1.0 is coming June 17th![/h2]
That’s right but that’s not all! We are also super excited to announce that [b]the game is also coming with a simultaneous release to Playstation 5 and Xbox Series S | X![/b] Check out our full announcement in the link below, including [b]our new announcement trailer![/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2066020/view/530970142088102701

[h2]New Art + Logo![/h2]
To mark this milestone, we completely [b]revamped the game’s key art and logo,[/b] as a reflection of how much the game changed and evolved through Early Access, thanks to your amazing support! Let us know what you think about the new visuals in the comments!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42629950/c0b8c07f6f41bf6b1577fb8c9350807411404616.png[/img]

[h2]New Supporter Pack DLC![/h2]
We are always incredibly humbled by the support we get from the community. We’d never imagine that people would like the game so much that they’d ask us for a way to support it even further. With you in mind, we’ve created our [b]Supporter Pack[/b], which is an additional content you can purchase to [b]give you access to 1 special skin per character, as well as a special thank you badge on the main menu![/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/53057/Soulstone_Survivors__Supporter_Pack/

So if you enjoy the game and want to support it further, check it out, but if not that’s alright too, [b]we already can’t thank you enough for playing the game and all the help we’ve got through Early Access![/b]

[h2]Update 16 - The Titan Hunt[/h2]
Now let’s get to the good stuff, the reason you are here! Today we are releasing the [b]BIGGEST[/b] update the game has ever seen, so without further ado lets jump right in! There is so much we want to show you that we decided to make a little [b]update trailer that you can check out below![/b]

[previewyoutube=Fw8-kwCWtIY;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]New Game Mode: The Titan Hunt![/h2]
Your endless search for power and answers leads you to distant lands, in a brutal hunt for the Titans. [b]Their blood is the key[/b], and it’s up to you to take their power and put it to good use!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42629950/44ae8abed3eb3f52c1fb2e4cc2bdb6f35a23b694.png[/img]

In this mode you travel through [b]Unstable Portals[/b] through different regions of the world in search of the next titan to hunt. Complete a series of challenges, [b]collect Void Fragments and use them to break the Titan’s seal[/b], and prepare for war.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42629950/5463b717828a409c88d13b30d0f3cf27b5bf4e2e.png[/img]

With the seal broken, all that is left is to face the Titans, [b]ancient foes that shaped the very essence of this world![/b] The spoils await for those who rise up to the challenge!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42629950/8694372f19192cff81dba2ee667fd76ff5fb42f5.png[/img]

As you eliminate these powerful foes, [b]collect their blood and learn new, build-defining powers,[/b] adding hundreds of new synergies that will [b]elevate your Void Hunters to the next level! [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42629950/b24563bd3ec844c71b721af97de8536953c56d6e.png[/img]

This update marks [b]Part 1[/b] of the [b]Titan Hunt[/b], with [b]Part 2 coming with the full release in June 17th[/b], so get ready, for there is still much to find out about the mysteries of the void!

[h2]New Void Hunter: The Shaman![/h2]
In your search for blood and power, only [b]the wisdom of the Shaman may keep the Void Hunters true to their purpose[/b] and protect them from corruption. This [b]whip-wielding warrior[/b] uses totems to harness the powers of his ancestors, with a [b]unique playstyle that focuses on high health and static defences to keep the void at bay.[/b]

Now you can craft [b]new weapons[/b], unlock [b]unique skills[/b], [b]runes[/b] and [b]perform an ancient ritual to call your spirit guides[/b] into battle!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42629950/c21e4cc8f2ae8c55f54624a8c066a1e1e0df3052.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42629950/8aaf461e004b5b508876baad0a8baf71aa93db4d.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42629950/f244c7aed4961efd5503aa8f124f848181b90412.png[/img]

[h2]New Buff - Ancestry[/h2]
Along with the Shaman we are introducing Ancestry, a [b]new buff[/b] where you can accumulate and spend stacks to [b]summon a powerful totem that harnesses your own life essence[/b], dealing increased damage based on your maximum health!

[h2]New Skill Trait - Fortitude[/h2]
This update also brings the [b]Fortitude[/b] skill trait! Units summoned by skills with this trait [b]deal extra damaged based on your maximum health[/b], in a powerful combo of resilience and strength!

[h2]New Feature: Minimap Support![/h2]
You will also notice a new feature across the game, [b]the Minimap![/b] It comes with information about all sorts of things, [b]from ascensions to minerals to bosses and enemies…[/b] it is filled with useful information to help you find your footing!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42629950/4fe2af5671af2d3cac0d9c9e227fe771f061d184.png[/img]

[h2]New Feature: Bonus Challenges[/h2]
While playing in the [b]Void Fields[/b] or the new [b]Titan Hunt[/b] you may notice a few new things going on around you… [b]loot chests, huge minerals, or even the sneaky Treasure Bug[/b] traveling through the planes… these optional special events can be completed to get some of that [b]sweet sweet loot![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42629950/fa25f7639017bc7cd08e385914ae9f43de61315d.png[/img]

[h2]Improved Visuals: Menu and more[/h2]
As we get closer and closer to the game’s full release, we are bringing [b]even more visual updates to the game![/b] You may notice the menu is a bit… different now… and it all has a reason to be… the answers as to what is going on with the Void Hunters… why are you even hunting titans… [b]it all lies in our next major update, so keep an eye out![/b]

[h2]General fixes and improvements:[/h2]
[list]
[*]Made small changes to achievements to accomodate the new game mode. Completing the 5 Void Fields maps will now unlock the Unholy Cathedral, and completing the first ritual in the Cathedral unlocks the Titan Hunt. Previous rewards were moved to different achievements;
[*]Fixed a possible crashing issue when there were too many units active (such as from tons of summons);
[*]Added Rune Tooltips when you hover over a rune, to make it easier to find what you are looking for;
[*]Heat Explosion no longer deals extra damage based on your Area of Effect, it now consumes all Burn damage accumulated on the target, dealing 200% of the total damage instantly;
[*]Subdue base damage increased from 50 to 100, and damage per stack from 8 to 30;
[*]Bombardment, Cluster Bomb and Trickster Decoy now have their negative effects also scaling with the damage multiplier of those skills;
[*]Shrapnel Bomb base damage reduced from 375 to 200, and damage per stack reduced from 20 to 4;
[*]Chaoswalker’s ascension blessings are now considerably stronger, and may no longer grant you additional movement speed so that movement is still predictable;
[*]Reduced the interaction time of Chaoswalker’s ascension considerably;
[*]The Chaotic trait now has double the chance to chain into another skill;
[*]Adjusted the scroll speed in the Damage Breakdown popup;
[*]Chaotic Surge and Krakens Rum no longer count as area skills;
[*]Multiple usability fixes on interfaces across the game;
[/list]

[h2]1.0 Price Increase and Special 40% Discount[/h2]
It’s crazy to look back and see [b]how much the game changed and evolved across Early Access[/b], and we cannot thank you enough for your support along the way. It has been a long road, but one we are extremely proud of and happy to be taking, and with the full release just around the corner, we felt it was the time to [b]adjust the game’s price to reflect all of the new content available in the game.[/b]

notes.title: Devlog #16 - The Shaman & Skill Tree Secrets
notes.content:
[h1]Greetings, Void Hunters![/h1]

The whispers of the Void have [b]grown into a roar[/b]—Devlog #16 is here, and it’s [i]packed [/i]with cool new things! The enigmatic [b]Shaman[/b] is right around the corner, alongside some[i] spicy new skill tree news[/i]. Let’s get into it!

[h3]The Shaman: Master of Totems[/h3]
[b]The moment you’ve been waiting for is here.[/b] The shadowy figure teased in Devlog #15 has stepped into the light, and [i]oh boy[/i], does he bring the storm... and poison... and.. you get the idea... Let’s break down his [b]otherworldly-totemic toolkit![/b]

[h3]New Skills: Total Totem Madness[/h3]
The Shaman’s abilities are [b]all about totems[/b] and what they can do to help in the battlefield. We’ve cranked the totem usage this time around and we even have a [b]new trait called: Ancestry[/b] which will consume stacks to summon totems for you! We really did go all in on it and it is reaching some [i]ludicrous levels of totemic madness.[/i] [b]Behold![/b] As The Shaman summons a variety of them to absolutely decimate the void.
[previewyoutube=xb4dVP2rZEU;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]Shaman’s Ascension: From Sketch to Spectacle[/h3]
As always the Ascension is the second thing we decided after deciding on the character, and we wanted to reinforce the [b]ritualistic nature of the character[/b] in his ascension. After [i]many many many[/i] hours of discussion, trying to figure out how to be thematic, simple to interact with but different at the same time… this is what we defined:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42629950/22f22deab502c7e0480bfd8b6aa22116d94337d5.png[/img]

Doesn't look like much hahaha, but we were excited! We thought “what if the Shaman danced around a ritual pyre to invoke ancestral spirits, maybe even gods… to fight for him?” and at that point we were all convinced! [b]But would it be fun? [/b]Only one way to find out! Here’s a rare glimpse at the very first prototype of his ascension, where we experimented with his ritual circle:
[previewyoutube=cOfP7ERIvg8;full][/previewyoutube]
This was an very early version focused on the testing of its functionality alone, it required so many spins around the pyre that you might become a Shaman yourself after performing a ritual this long… so we tweaked here and there… made a few new visuals… replaced a thing or two… and…

[b]Behold—the final form.[/b]
[previewyoutube=36rVxNXgJOA;full][/previewyoutube]
When the Shaman’s ascension triggers, otherworldly beings come to assist the Shaman. They surge into the battlefield, amplifying his powers into a [b][i]cataclysmic crescendo.[/i][/b] The screen gets filled with these ancient beings and the Shaman becomes a conduit for them. [b][i]It’s equal parts terrifying and glorious.[/i][/b] (And yes, that is indeed a gigantic and ancient fire-bird-god thing.)

[h3]Beyond the Shaman: Skill Tree Secrets in the Static[/h3]
After many iterations to this system we are finally able to see it completed. Here’s a [i]sneak peek[/i]—but don’t squint too hard, we’ve blurred the juiciest bits:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42629950/03e909110928639b7928ad196eae3bb2893c5d17.png[/img]
New branches, synergies, and [i]mystery nodes[/i] await. [b]What’s hidden in the fog and blurriness?[/b] You’ll find out… [i]soon[/i].

[h3]Closing Thoughts: The Void Grows Hungrier[/h3]
The Shaman is coming soon, being followed close after by his two… [b][i]mysterious[/i][/b] friends… but this is still just a prelude to something [i]even bigger lurking[/i] in the shadows…

[b]Sound off in the comments:[/b]
[list]
[*]  Are you looking forward for the Shaman’s totem-summoning madness?
[*]  What do you think the blurred Skill Tree nodes hide?
[*]  You all know we are working on a new game mode, with new bosses and maps… but there is something else… another [b]HUGE[/b] feature in development… what do you think it could be? PS: its not coop, not yet =( 
[/list]
Your theories (and screams of joy/terror) fuel our development. Keep ‘em coming!

As always, thank you for your [i]relentless[/i] support. The Void may be endless, but so is our hype.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42629950/0613ae8b16cc071c726ac24a6c6e0f9156b2c8a2.gif[/img]

[b]~ The Soulstone Team[/b]

notes.title: Devlog #14 - Reworked Ascensions Gameplay & Community Skins
notes.content:
[h1]Greetings, Void Hunters![/h1]

Welcome to the [b]second Soulstone Survivors devlog of 2025![/b] While we continue to work on some [b]HUGE[/b] features in the background, we are also fine-tuning some of the ascensions that you’ve given feedback on. Back in devlog #11 we shared some early work-in-progress preview on it and today we are happy to share a [b]sneak peak of a much more polished iteration of the new ascension gameplay.[/b]

[h2]Hound Master’s Ascension[/h2]

We’ve mentioned before that we wanted to make Hound Master’s dogs a main part of his ascension, making it [b]more visually interesting and exciting to play with.[/b] We’ve already shared some screenshots and details on how that would look like in game. Today, we are ready to share some actual footage of its new and improved gameplay: 
[previewyoutube=eo3iVnDM7U0;full][/previewyoutube]
As you can see, the doggies are now [b]MUCH[/b] more expressive in showing their power. They now grow in size quite a bit and also glow in different colors when they gain a new level. While it gets harder and harder to maintain their power level with each upgrade, their buffs get exponentially stronger, so [b]they can truly destroy everything.[/b] It continues to be a relatively low-effort ascension, but now with possibly huge rewards!

[i][b]In the end we were able to honor the memory of our very own doggo, Zippie, in a very cool way. Rest in Peace, Zippie.[/b][/i]

[h2]Legionnaire’s Ascension[/h2]

In a very similar fashion, we previously discussed how and why we were going to change the Legionnaire’s Ascension. While we liked its idea, it always lacked some… punch. Now instead of building catapults, through your bravery in battle, you can be [b]promoted to Centurion, calling the full support of your legion with powerful bonuses![/b] Here’s how that looks like in game:
[previewyoutube=XiToK_iM6S8;full][/previewyoutube]
Once you have patched up your fellow wounded soldiers, they will fight by your side until the bitter end. If you manage to save enough soldiers to have yourself a small army, the powers of a true spartan leader show, turning the skies blood-red, [b]tinted with the rage of your legions.[/b] While active, your legion becomes a force to be reckoned with!

[h2]Community Skins[/h2]

We’ve recently announced an early access to our new [b]Community Skins feature![/b] It’s been out for a couple of weeks now and we’ve already got over two dozen awesome skins of all kinds, from wizards to legendary medieval warriors, from dual-pistols to a pear-on-a-fork (that’s right!), crafted by our community. Check them out in our [url=http://mod.io/g/soulstonesurvivors]mod.io page[/url] 

You can play with them right now by switching to the communityskins branch here on Steam. Follow the info on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2066020/view/500563239247020266]this post[/url] for how to get started.  

You may recall from the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/2066020/announcements/detail/500563239247020267]announcement post[/url] that we’d be running a competition to award the most up-voted skins over the following couple of weeks. That competition has now finished and we are very happy with how it turned out. We’ll contact the winners over the coming days and prepare a showcase of the winning line-up!

If you fancy creating your very own weapons or characters to share with the community (or even to just for yourself), we’ve prepared some cool guides on how to get started: [url=https://mod.io/g/soulstonesurvivors/r/creating-a-character-skin]Creating a Character Skin Guide | Creating a Weapon Skin.[/url] Sounds like something that’d be super hard, but it’s actually quite easy, [b]barely an inconvenience! [/b]Hey, you might even get a chance to participate in one of the Community Skins competition in the future!

[h3]Closing Thoughts[/h3]

We are very excited to get these and [b]other massive changes[/b] we have been secretly working on your hands. We are also excited to seeing you play and receiving your feedback! Let us know [b]what you think about these changes in the comments below,[/b] and keep an eye out, we barely scratched the surface of what is to come…

We hope you have a lovely day or night,

notes.title: Community Skins are here!
notes.content:
[b][h2]Greetings, Void Hunters! [/h2][/b]
[b]We have an exciting new feature coming and we need your help![/b]

We are introducing [b]Community Skins[/b] to the game! We have integrated Soulstone Survivors with Mod.io and we are looking for awesome players to [b]be among the first to add their creations[/b] to the game’s library before this feature is released to the public!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42629950/cc0cc32332afa63832f6ed750d2013f4443fc137.gif[/img]

You will now be able to create and share [b]your own custom 3D models of characters AND weapons as free skins[/b] to all players! Not only will you be helping us in test out and improve this feature, but the [b]top voted creations will receive Steam Gift Cards AND be showcased in our feature release video[/b] once this update comes out to everyone!

If you are feeling inspired and would like to help us, it’s super easy, barely an inconvenience! We have prepared two [b]official guides[/b] that go through all the steps, so check out the details below:


[h2]How do I participate?[/h2]
First, you will need to access a special version of the game. To do this, go to [b]your Steam Library[/b], right click [b]Soulstone Survivors[/b], go into [b]“Properties”[/b], and under the [b]“Betas”[/b] tab, you will see a drop-down next to [b]“Beta Participation”.[/b] Click it and you will see an option called [b]“communityskins”[/b]. Select it, and your game will update to a different version.

[b]Step 1:[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42629950/20824c758047ab3998a2ec25446d1221c5b6d798.png[/img]
[b]Step 2:[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42629950/09ead6621a9b5abdd7ca523898f03c320167b721.png[/img]
[i][b][h3]Warning! Any game progress you make while in this version of the game will not be saved! Your save files will be safe, but make sure to use this version ONLY to create skins!![/h3][/b][/i]

[h2]How to download, create and share skins?[/h2]
[b]To download skins[/b] all you have to do is go to [b]Characters -> Appearances -> Community Skins[/b]. This will open the Mod.io interface where you can browse and subscribe to any skins you fancy!

[url=https://mod.io/g/soulstonesurvivors/r/creating-a-character-skin]Creating a Character Skin Guide[/url]

Since this feature is still [b]under development[/b], we are sure there will be a few bumps along the way. We advise you to [b]backup your save files[/b] before you proceed. You can find your save files in the following folders:

[b]On Windows:[/b] %USERPROFILE%\AppData\LocalLow\Game Smithing\Soulstone Survivors\
[b]On Linux:[/b] .config/unity3d/Game Smithing/Soulstone Survivors
[b]On Mac:[/b] ~/Library/Application Support/com.GameSmithing.SoulstoneSurvivors/

If you run into any issues, make sure to let us know! You can contact us on our official Discord [url=https://discord.gg/ZmBXwZbPpb](https://discord.gg/gamesmithing)[/url], or the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2066020/discussions/5/]Steam Forums[/url]!

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42629950/34faf4f65fa1cec13972f5aa7e53f862fc5adbd7.png[/img]
[h3][b]Greetings, Void Hunters! :sssthumb:[/b][/h3]

Welcome to the [b]first Soulstone Survivors devlog of 2025![/b] We have been working on some HUGE features in the background, and while we have [b]another official Content Sneak Peek coming very soon[/b], we couldn’t help ourselves and make some sneak peeks here in the devlog as well! As part of a… [b]grander scheme[/b], we have upgraded the visuals of many parts of the game and today we wanted to share a first look with you!

[h2][b]Visual Upgrades[/b][/h2]

[h3]Maps[/h3]
As you all might have seen from our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2066020/allnews/]recent Content Sneak Peeks[/url], we are working on [b]adding new maps to the game[/b], and it felt like the perfect time to revisit some of the old maps as well. Today we wanted to share with you the [b]new visuals[/b] for the Scorching Valley and the Whispering Grove!

[b]Here is a quick comparison of what these maps used to look like and now:[/b]
[previewyoutube=FJoGth-YmU0;full][/previewyoutube]
[previewyoutube=JI4mcLA71ew;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]Main Menu[/h2]
While at it, another area that needed major improvements was our main menu scenario! There are still a few changes coming to this one later on, but [b]check out the video below for a gist of what’s coming next:[/b]
[previewyoutube=-Y7YRm2GZtM;full][/previewyoutube]
These visual changes are all part of a greater set of changes coming with the new game mode, with the new maps… and well… with the new surprises coming to the game in the coming updates. In terms of updates I think it is safe to say we saved the best for last, so keep an eye out for the future content sneak peeks as we will start sharing more details very soon!

[h2]Faster Save File Loading[/h2]
Another huge refactor we have been working on is regarding the loading times of the game. They can be quite painful in slower devices, and specifically your save files, if they are large enough from a high number of matches, your loading time could be huge! We changed a few screws around, got some better building materials, new tools, gave it a little slap and now it loads a lot faster! (honestly, the slap alone might have done it). What you will watch below is not an artificial test, [b]we are actually loading a pretty gigantic save[/b], that belongs to Faydaen [b](thanks for all the help Faydaen!!)[/b]:

[b]Check this comparison out:[/b]
[previewyoutube=Am94qrRDvwg;full][/previewyoutube]
The timer in the video above shows just how long it took to properly read and load the player’s save file and populate the necessary data in-game to continue ahead. Our new system which includes a custom made serializer and a ton of other changes is almost instant even in a huge save like this one, while before it could take over 20 seconds just loading the [b]SAME[/b] save file! There are also improvements in all other loading screens in the game, like loading levels and what not, so hopefully that should make the experience a lot smoother!

[h2]
Closing Thoughts[/h2]

We are getting closer and closer to releasing a few massive features we have been working on for a while, along with some [b]exciting announcements[/b] we are preparing in the background, and we are [b]SUPER[/b] excited about everything that is coming next! Let us know [b]what you think about these visual upgrades in the comments below[/b], and keep an eye out, we got a lot more to show!

We hope you have a lovely day or night,

notes.title: Update 14g - Major Performance Improvements and Fixes
Devlog #12 - New Game Mode, Boss + Projectile performance!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42629950/34faf4f65fa1cec13972f5aa7e53f862fc5adbd7.png[/img]
[h3][b]Greetings, Void Hunters! ːsssthumbː[/b][/h3]

We bid you welcome to yet another Soulstone Survivors Devlog! In this one we are going to dig a bit [b]deeper[/b] into our first [b]Content Sneak Peek[/b] (if you missed it check out the post below), talk a lilttle about the [b]new game mode[/b] and share some [b]massive performance gains coming soon![/b] This is a good one, so grab your tea or coffee, get comfy and come with me!

https://steamcommunity.com/games/2066020/announcements/detail/4441207839043617810

[h2]Special Edition Dev Talk[/h2]
First, we wanted to announce that we are working on a special edition Dev Talk! We will share what we have learned so far from developing Soulstone Survivors, and more importantly, [b]how we are using these lessons in the creation of the new future content![/b]

In this edition we will also share further details about what you can expect from [b]our next game mode, which is going to be, by very far, the BIGGEST content update[/b] to the game ever!

[h3]It’s coming out on our [url=https://www.youtube.com/@gamesmithing/videos]YouTube channel[/url] on December 21st, so keep an eye out![/h3]

[h2]Content Sneak Peek - Mhyzahet, Terror of the Sands[/h2]
A couple of weeks ago we updated our public roadmap, and together with it our first sneak peek into a HUGE content update that is coming! There is A LOT more where that came from and we will reveal the next sneak peek next Friday, but today we wanted to look at bit closer at [b]Mhyzahet, one of the new bosses coming to the game![/b]

[previewyoutube=xFY65Tz9vA8;full][/previewyoutube]
Some of you noticed that this boss might not work exactly like the others do… so I thought it would be fun to [b]share a little bit more![/b]

[i][b]First a little trivia:[/b] Did you know that all bosses in the game are named after the developers and people important to us? This time around is no different, for this one we decided to pay homage to Mhysa, an incredibly kind and awesome member of our [url=https://discord.gg/gamesmithing]Discord community[/url], the author of the incredible “Mhysa’s Guide to a Successful Survivor”! [b]The game wouldn’t be the same without you Mhysa![/b][/i]

Now, what can you expect from this encounter? Some of you noticed that this boss has a very specific place in the map… [b]a proper boss room![/b] This is coming as a part of our new game mode, where after you complete… well, lets say [i]“something”[/i] for now =P, you gain access to the boss of the map, in this case, [b]the Lair of Mhyzahet.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42629950/bcdc89299802194301caf3fff7458a5987fad558.png[/img]
This new boss is special in more than one way. We want it to be a meaningful encounter, and with a set layout for the boss room, [b]we can leverage the layout of the room to create more interesting skills.[/b] But not only you can expect a greater challenge, defeating this titanic creature will also grant you a [b]new type of unique power up, from a pool of power ups that can only be found from this specific boss![/b]

There is a lot more to talk about, but if you want to learn more details about how this new game mode will work, make sure to check out our [b]special edition Dev Talk mentioned above![/b]

[h2]Projectile Performance[/h2]
As you probably know by now, performance has been a big priority for us. We have made huge strides in multiple areas, but there is one that is currently the worst FPS killer… [b]the dreaded… projectiles ːssssadː![/b]

Skills like [b]Fan of Bombs[/b] currently can cause massive FPS drops if you abuse it with a lot of skill chains, multicast and cast frequency. For a long time we have been investigating what we could do to improve the situation… and well, [b]I’ll let the video below speak for itself:[/b]

[previewyoutube=tY4eMvcr38o;full][/previewyoutube]
In the video we are showcasing [b]Spreadshot[/b] with 10k Extra Cast chance and 10k Cast Frequency, also known as “crazy numbers”. First, we use the standard Spreadshot, which runs at an average of 13.8 FPS, or, in another words, using [b]72ms per frame[/b] (definitely not the slowest skill out there!). Then, we switch to the new and optimized Spreadshot in the exact same scenario, and it runs at an average of 47.8 FPS, or in another words, [b]using 20.9ms per frame.[/b] The graph below illustrates these numbers with more precision:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42629950/873435c277694a4982d1554ad68006388c02ac58.png[/img]
Now let me give you a [b]TL;DR:[/b] with the latest optimizations, [b]we managed to make projectiles 70% faster to run than before.[/b] Not all projectiles will get the full treatment because it is an arduous process, but ALL projectiles will be a lot faster! This end result is a combination of 3 techniques:

[olist]
[*][b]Remade physics logic:[/b] we now use a different, multithreaded logic to simulate the physics for projectiles, which is much, much faster than before. It does come at a small loss of precision, but the gains are massive and worth it in a game like ours;

[*][b]Remade visual effects:[/b] it might be hard to tell from the video because they look so similar, but a big part of the performance gain came from switching from the old Unity Particle System, to the new one. The new one is made to run in the GPU, so it has a smaller overhead in the CPU, which is most of the time the bottleneck. This is actually an arduous process because these systems are very different and we need to remake each projectile by hand, so we will probably implement this improvement slowly, only on the most dire projectiles;

[*][b]Repositioning projectiles instead of disabling them:[/b] I don’t want to get into too much detail here, but normally, when you are done with an object in a game, like an Enemy or a Projectile in this case, you “turn it off”, so that the Engine knows it doesnt need to care about it, but keeps the object in memory. Then, when you need a new Enemy or Projectile, you get this object again and place it in the position you want it, you turn it on again, telling the engine “hey, remember that projectile? we want to use it again”. This is known as [b]“object pooling”[/b] and is pretty standard since it is a lot faster to reuse something than create something new. Now… we noticed that just the act of “enabling” the projectile was causing a crazy high overhead, because the engine needs to “re-register” the projectile internally and do all sorts of stuff, and [b]in this very specific case of projectiles, just moving them away into outter space, and then moving them back, WITHOUT disabling them… made another huge performance difference.[/b] (PS: Dont do this at home kids, our architecture supports this well, but its not applicable for every game and architecture)
[/olist]
[h2]Closing Thoughts[/h2]
We are [b]extremely excited about the future of Soulstone Survivors,[/b] we have been working for months in the background on a couple of massive features and it [b]feels awesome[/b] to finally start to share more with you! Please do [b]let us know your thoughts about what you see in the comments below,[/b] and I hope to see you in the next one!

We hope you have a lovely day or night,

notes.title: Updated Roadmap + Content Sneak Peek #1
notes.content:
[b]Greetings, Void Hunters! ːsssthumbː[/b]

My name is Allan, I'm the lead developer of Soulstone Survivors and today I wanted to have a chat with [b]you.[/b] This November marks a very special time for us here at Game Smithing, as [b]Soulstone Survivors celebrates 2 years of Early Access[/b] ːsssloveː, and on top of that, our recent reviews just hit the amazing mark of 95% positive on Steam which is the best gift we could ask for! So to start, [b]I wanted to personally thank you,[/b] from the bottom of my heart, for all the support you have given us so far!

As a little thank you, we have prepared a couple things to share with you today that we hope you will enjoy!

[h3]First, it's a long time coming but today we are finally sharing our new [b]Content Roadmap![/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42629950/b6103dfe6595b9d34beec744c162dcbc1da020e4.png[/img]
[i]PS: You can also find the localized version of the roadmap in our game page, in all the languages we support.[/i]

Now, while its certainly great to have a public roadmap to give you all a better sense of what to expect from the game moving forward... there is only so much we can show in the roadmap itself. We got a ton of stuff in the works, some of which we have been working on for quite a long time in the background and while we ourselves are super excited about it... we want to get you excited about it as well! With that in mind, starting here and now, we present to you our first...

[h2]Content Sneak Peek #1[/h2]
Over the coming weeks and months we will be sharing small [b]videos to showcase all the new stuff[/b] we are working on in secret for a while... I know some of you might feel like all we do these days is work in new characters and you want to see something different... so to begin with we prepared a little something for you:
[previewyoutube=Wd_acmFQYgs;full][/previewyoutube]
You might be wondering... is this another regular map? Is this a regular boss?? What else is coming??? [b]When will this be released????[/b] To find the answer to all of these questions... keep an eye out for out next Content Sneak Peek video! We plan to release those regularly moving forward as we prepare for what will be, [b]BY VERY FAR,[/b] the biggest update the game has ever seen!

[h2]The journey so far[/h2]
I also felt like this was a great time to reflect on the journey so far. When Soulstone Survivors came into Early Access on 7th November of 2022, our team was mainly composed of 3 people, Alex, Gama and me. For most of the time we still had our old jobs and we were working basically all night to get a cool game done. At that time we were also VERY lucky to have the amazing help of our friends Fernando, Tiago and Aruan, which were instrumental to get us to the finish line when we did. At that time we were still unsure of how the game would be received, what people would like, would NOT like... but we had built in our heads a plan for what the "full release" of the game would be, which then became our first public Roadmap (added as a thumbnail below, because its huge haha you can click on it to view its details):

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42629950/2a19d1d738b989ae483b1da76f1cfefed49b06ff.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42629950/acc1dac28cff019642447b79c51f59982ccaede2.png[/img][/url]

As you can see, our vision for Soulstone Survivors was always for it to be a deep game, with tons of skills and ways to build your character, this was the pillar we were building the game upon. We wanted to add a lot of skills, characters, weapons, we knew we wanted to try playing with new game modes... but, we didnt want to promise anything we would not be able to make with our tiny team. So while it was already a lot of content to develop, we kept it simple, comfortable, something we thought "yeah we can do this over the next year if we really put our all into it, hopefully with the game release we will be able to support ourselves and get there".

Then we released into Early Access, and we couldn't believe the reception the game had right from the start. There were literally thousands of players playing the game simultaneously, tons of people joining our Discord, participating in the Steam forums, interested in the game and sharing their experiences... and we just couldn't believe our eyes. We felt honored, humbled, overjoyed... and a minute later despair haha there were so many things to fix, to improve, to add... and while it was a TON of work, literally sleeping once every 3 days for a few weeks... we were just super excited to do it. Once the fires settled a little bit, we released a lot of hotfix updates and even some new content, we took a step back, a deep breath, and thought "what comes next?"

We had our plans of what the game could be, of what we could build with our little team... but we also had all of these other cool ideas we dreamed of implementing, and you guy also had so many great ideas we knew would make a huge difference for the game, so we had to make a choice. Either we stick to the plan to hit full release around a year after the start of Early Access and deliver a pretty cool game, or, we could listen to you, to the community, and to our own hearts and aim to make Soulstone Survivors the best game it can be. I can safely say this was a pretty obvious choice for all of us.

We immediatelly started hiring new developers to give us more hands as we had a lot of ambitious features and goals to tackle, and thats when we really started working on a lot of the features that you find in the game today, such as Character Ascensions, Character Skill Trees, major reworks on skill types... ah, way too many to mention!! Sometimes I think of what might have been... if we had stuck to the plan maybe today we would have the game fully released, we might even have a whole new game pretty much done (I'm looking at you Rogue Soulstone), but then I remember everything we added to the game that wouldnt be there... remember all the messages of support, of players thanking us for adding this or that... I look at the game we have today... and I know that we have made the right choice.

There is still a lot of hard work ahead of us till get the to the full release and more work after that as well, and every day I feel lucky for this opportunity to work on a game I love, with an amazing team, the best community, and all the amazing people we met along the way. Here's to you, to Soulstone Survivors, and for all that's still coming!

I hope you have a great day, and I'll see you all in the next one!

notes.title: Devlog #11 - Reworked Ascensions!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42629950/34faf4f65fa1cec13972f5aa7e53f862fc5adbd7.png[/img]
[b]Greetings, Void Hunters[/b]!

Welcome to another Soulstone Survivors Devlog! This one is a week late as we have been hard at work on the new [b][REDACTED][/b], but today we wanted to bring more details to you about a few cool changes we are working on!

[h2]Ascensions Rework[/h2]
When we first introduced the Ascensions system, we wanted those to feel like [b]impactful gameplay mechanics[/b] unique to each character, to further distinguish their playstyles. They [b]intentionally have varying levels of reward and demand[/b], some might basically happen automatically while others might be more involved, and we like that they [b]feel different[/b]. However, with your feedback and our own testing we know that [b]some ascensions felt just underwhelming or cumbersome[/b] to interact with. We have already improved in many ways quite a few of those powers, but [b]there are two that are getting major overhaul[/b] to how they work in the next update.

[h2]Hound Master’s Ascension[/h2]
While we definitely want to make[b] his dogs a main part of his ascension power[/b], right now it is probably the least interesting ascension in how it works. You basically feed your dogs and they get stronger, which conceptually is fine, but in practice what happens is you feed them so much that [b]it is never a decision[/b], it is just about “get a few beefs now and then and they will be fine”. We wanted to keep the general concept, but [b]make it more visually interesting and exciting to play with.[/b]

[h3]New Mechanics and Visuals[/h3]
To begin with, we completely remade his [b]Ascension bar[/b], which now looks like this:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42629950/42bf4a5af865301f1a916ff8318aecb9ba5be9d5.png[/img]

The overall concept is still very similar: [b]your goal is to make sure your doggies are well fed[/b], but here’s how it works in the new system:

You might have noticed that the doggie is on a [b]sort of track[/b]. The doggies will always be walking towards the blue bowl, and your objective is to fill it with food (that still drops from the monsters) [b]before[/b] the doggie gets to it! Whenever you pick up a piece of meat, it will show up on the blue bowl at the end of the track, and once its done, the doggie will rush to eat and [b]will be very pleased to enjoy a nice meal[/b], gaining a major buff and increasing in size:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42629950/923b4d7f0d09fad8c998575d5c65b3b49fff2ddb.png[/img]

He will then go back to his little house, but now that they are bigger [b]they will get hungry faster[/b]… so you have less time to fill the bowl again. If you do it, they will keep getting more and more buffs and growing bigger and bigger and becoming real [b]killing machines[/b]… however, should you fail to feed them in time before they are hungry, [b]the doggie will be very sad indeed[/b], and lose all its buffs and go back to his original size:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42629950/958e9c659989b3877d50528d09add4a46f6fb682.png[/img]

The ascension still has different power levels to it, which can go on forever. The higher the level, represented by the number above the doggie in the images, the bigger the buff the dogs receive to their stats and the [b]larger and hungrier they will grow[/b], which means they need to eat more frequently and eventually will go back to their original form.

We believe that this new functionality will bring those [b]surges in power[/b] you expect to see from an ascension, where at times they will be absolutely [b]destroying everything[/b], and then you get a lull period where you start to build up this momentum again. This also makes it [b]so beefs are relevant for the whole match[/b], and you might want to time them so you give your dogs a mega boost very quickly to deal with Lords of the Void, or just get them stronger more often and for longer with more balanced feeding.

[b]Allan[/b] also wanted to share a few words about this new mechanic:
[i]“The Hound Master has always been one of my favourite characters and I’m glad we are giving him and these little doggies they love they deserve. This rework is especially dear to me, as I’ve recently lost my great friend Zippie, our little family doggo, the greatest little Westie we could have, that Alex referenced in the new UI… so now every time I play, Ill remember my little buddy.”[/i]

[h2]Legionnaire’s Ascension[/h2]
When we first came up with the original Legionnaire’s ascension, we always [b]knew it was a bit of a risk[/b]. We knew it would feel different from the others due to its ramp up which then becomes entirely passive, and while conceptually the idea sounded cool, [b]building catapults that crush your enemies[/b], in practice the ramp up is so gradual that once again, you [b]never have that “power surge”[/b] we wanted to create with ascensions, so it was time for a [b]major rework.[/b]

[h3]New mechanics and Visuals[/h3]
Again, lets begin by checking out his new [b]Ascension bar[/b], that now looks like this:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42629950/71d54cf0dba9c0e7be76263f56cb4a5eb4f290da.png[/img]

Now, while you fight against the creatures of the void, you are going to come across [b]wounded legionnaires.[/b] Your objective is to help them get back into shape to [b]fight by your side.[/b] Once you have enough soldiers fighting at your side, you are able to call the [b]full support of your army by carrying your war banner to battle![/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42629950/c52f41338772dc2bdc83e2ab2bef0e523bc73e70.png[/img]

But that is not all, of course. As the worth leader of a strong legion, enraged and encouraged, your lust for carnage will change even the scenery around you, [b]transforming it into a deep red[/b], where you will hear the sounds of the rough battles ahead, befitting of a legion commander. You will be given [b]extra legionnaires[/b] to fight for you along with [b]powerful buffs[/b], while your army fires catapult boulders and bursts of arrows over the battlefield with a very high frequency, [b]making it rain on your enemies.[/b] The ascension will have a set, fixed duration and will grant you a huge, and temporary, boost in power.

Once it ends, the war banner disappears and all extra legionnaires along with it, and you can start forming a new legion once again. With these changes, we are not only bring the major swing in power you get from other ascensions, but also the [b]epic feeling of being a legion commander[/b] and being in the middle of an all out war, making it as exciting as it should be!

[h2]Closing Thoughts[/h2]
While we are excited about these changes to these two ascensions, we still have a lot of [b]new stuff[/b] to share with you! You can check our post earlier today for a liiiittle sneak peek of what is coming up soon...
https://steamcommunity.com/games/2066020/announcements/detail/4441207839043617780

We will also [b]FINALLY[/b] publish our [b]revised roadmap[/b] tomorrow alongside a proper content sneak peek of something… [b]a bit different…[/b] so if you are interested in learning more about what is coming make sure to check it out!

We hope you have a lovely day or night,

Devlog #10 - The Cursed Captain!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42629950/34faf4f65fa1cec13972f5aa7e53f862fc5adbd7.png[/img]
Ahoy, Void Hunters!! We bid yer welcome onboard of our latest update [b]the Cursed Fleet[/b]. We’re excited to share some pirate concept art and character insights, reworked ascensions, and more!

[h3]As we progress further into development, we also invite you to sign up to our [url=https://gamesmithing.com/news/][b]new mailing list[/b][/url] and be among the first to find out when its released![/h3]

[h3]Development Process: The Cursed Captain[/h3]
In our Devlog #9, we shared sketches and discussed the principles that guide our character design. This time, we're thrilled to reveal some of the actual work that goes into creating our newest Void Hunter: The [b]Cursed Captain![/b]

[h3]Cursed Captain - Visuals[/h3]
When the team decided on what the new character would be, Alex went ahead and created these awesome concepts below:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42629950/169623538282c200a201e9452f4f4d3f8b3e790d.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42629950/edd209c9fceff3b270bd2dd9d5cf62961192201e.png[/img]
Our aptly named 3D Artist, Colombo then [b]transformed the concept into the playable character[/b] we get to enjoy, but this also came with its challenges. To create the menu animation, which shows the character using a rope to drop down to the scene, Colombo used a script/plugin called SpringMagic which simplifies doing this kind of real life physics simulation.

[b]Unfortunately this simulation doesn’t create keyframes,[/b] making it impossible to export the file and use it in the game engine. So, to circumvent this, there is a lot of manual testing, tweaking and thinkery involved to make it work.

For the Captain, it was even more challenging because he is [b]holding the rope,[/b] so Colombo couldn’t let the simulation make the rope move, rotate, or twist freely; otherwise, [b]the character’s hands and feet would follow and distort the entire character:[/b]
[previewyoutube=nKd_ZYXnqvU;full][/previewyoutube]
So, even after simulating the rope, there were a lot of adjustments to be made by hand which ultimately resulted in [b]the cool animation we see today:[/b]
[previewyoutube=MlmXtCcEZ1E;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]Cursed Captain - Ascension[/h3]
When we design these characters, we also try to keep our player base’s desires in mind while trying to create something that both feels good, is fun to play and has its own quirks for you to test out and explore, but of course, this always comes without its own challenges. 

While we were thinking of the captain’s ascension, we wanted to [b]make something that felt epic and impactful[/b] so the Ghost Ship sailing across the map blasting monsters was the first idea we had, but due to limitations such as the top-down view, visual pollution and constant player movement, we had to go through different iterations before getting to the version we have in the game now. 

[b]Our first idea[/b] as you can also see in our Devlog #9, [b]was to make the ship circle the player from just out of the screen and shoot in a straight line,[/b] but it didn’t feel quite… right. We took a lot of time discussing how much screen time the boat was getting and how we did not want the boat to look like it was directly “linked” or “connected” to the player, as you can see in the video below:
[previewyoutube=Y-yzZR6vEPE;full][/previewyoutube]
The main challenge here was [b]trying to make the movement of the boat “feel” natural,[/b] while having it visible “sometimes” but not ALL the time (as it gets in the way).

We had to come up with a movement logic where the boat was always nearby, but if you saw it, it looked like it was sailing naturally, which means no hard turns, no weird stops… but if it sailed naturally all the time, it would be very hard to see the boat, as it would make very large turns and sail away most of the time. [b]The solution was to make the ship kind of loop around[/b], trying to get close to the player all the time, so it is always turning to try to get to a certain distance from you, but when it is off screen, it speeds up based on how far away it is from you, so [b]you don't see the boat turning around at 500mph to come back to you[/b] if you happen to intercept it somewhere in the map. Since the ship would be far away, we had to change its attack to be in an arc, so that it could have global range and still make an impact. Check out the difference in the video below:
[previewyoutube=8efVx6AFySQ;full][/previewyoutube]
While thinking of what uniqueness the pirate could bring to the game alongside its ascension, of course [b]rum immediately came to our minds[/b] (figuratively, maybe a little literally too) and thus was born the Pirate Rum rune! Alongside a new type of Versatility runes, which we are internally calling “the meme type”. If you ever wanted to know what it was like to play the game drunk and probably throw up here ya go:
[previewyoutube=6ie7DoX9Vwk;full][/previewyoutube]
[i][b]“What will we do with the drunken sailor early in the morniiing? Way hay and up she rises!”[/b][/i]

[h3]Cursed Captain - Character identity[/h3]
When designing a new character, once we have the theme and the ascension ready, its time to think of the skills and how they will give the character a unique playstyle but also play well with existing skills, which is easier said than done when we already have hundreds of skills in the game.

For the Captain, in addition to a few new skill behaviors such as Plunder Shot that gives you Ammunition when the projectile hits enemies and Cursed Shot that is a projectile that hits the same target multiple times, we also wanted to bring something that tied together the theme of the character and its mechanics.

We already have a [b]few instances of exclusive traits[/b] such as the Assassin that has [b]Backstab,[/b] so we started thinking of [b]what would be fitting for this character[/b] but also interesting for other characters, and that is [b]how Cursed came to be. [/b] It works essentially like Electrified or Radiance, in this case you get X stacks of this buff to summon a ghostly tentacle, which strongly reinforces the theme of the character and brings the presence of the ghost tentacles to every weapon, becoming almost synonymous with the Captain. 

[b]Check out the video below for some cursed gameplay:[/b]
[previewyoutube=ZPJBF54FJR4;full][/previewyoutube]
Gunpowder is also [b]a new trait being introduced to the game,[/b] where a skill is no longer launched automatically, but instead,[b] it consumes your Ammunition buff and is launched 5 times.[/b] We really like the concept of Ammunition, but if you made an ammunition stacking build before, you probably have had situations where you just stacked too much and couldn't spend all your ammunition. It is also sad when an uninspiring skill ends up consuming ammunition instead of your heavy hitter, and Gunpowder allowed us to create a sort of "Ammunition finisher" skill, that is super powerful and synergizes really well with a lot of what is already in the game, such as Ammo Box, and also opens up opportunities for other similar effects in the future, skills that depend on something to be used instead of just being automatically casted.

[b]Check out this video below of gunpowder gameplay:[/b]
[previewyoutube=d6OlH5croYM;full][/previewyoutube]

We hope that the cursed captain brings interesting and fun new gameplay for all to enjoy! We hope you all have fun with it. And as always, we’d love to hear your thoughts! Let us know in the comments!

[b]We hope you are having a lovely day or night,[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42629950/0613ae8b16cc071c726ac24a6c6e0f9156b2c8a2.gif[/img]

[i][b]~ The Soulstone Team[/b][/i]

[h2]Behind The Scenes of Void Hunters Design[/h2]
Since you all seemed to enjoy our beautiful sketch of the Unholy Cathedral boss and fight, we though of sharing even more sketches! This time around, we wanted to talk about how we approach character design! At this stage in the game, when designing a new character we generally start by first looking at what skill types and fantasies are under represented in the existing characters, to help us guide the theme and what sort of mechanics will be expected.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42629950/bc8053a3f2c1bf519cccdbfbb312b508702ecba7.png[/img]
[b][i]“What if the thing went around and as you move it keeps its distance…?”[/i][/b]

Once those are defined, we make a high level decision about the theme and name of the class this Void Hunter will represent and what weapons it will use, but still subject to change. Once we are happy, the first thing we decide is the character’s ascension, which helps us nail down exactly what the general theme of the character will be both for gameplay mechanics and visuals. For the Demon Hunter, for example, we wanted a Void Hunter that uses ranged weapons but also dips into chaotic magic, so the class felt like an obvious answer. Our theme for the Demon Hunter is a Void Hunter that through his mastery of hunting the most corrupted demons of the void, learned to harness this same power and even control said demons to do his bidding, but still resists the temptation to become corrupted himself.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42629950/f01c3b15cbd5577942bdd4eefa0c993db8b73167.png[/img]
[b][i]“… then maybe the thing makes these cross yellow lines (that I dont want to spoil what they represent) go that direction? / ah yeah, that would be awesome!”[/i][/b]

After that is out of the way, we start talking about the skills themselves. At this point we already know what skill types each weapon will have, and these will have a big impact not only on the visual theme of the skill but also in what the skill does, mechanically speaking. 

Designing skills is actually quite challenging, since we have to be mindful of our game’s limitations, such as the top down point of view, auto casted skills, crazy scaling over a match, performance implications and how often each skill gets used, etc. At this point we try to come up with unique mechanics that feel refreshing to play with, but that also can fill gaps in our huge roster of skills, thinking not only of how the skills will work but how they compliment the existing content in the game. This is usually a very long process, and in the end we hope it turns out to be a fun new character!

This was all we had for today! Hope you enjoyed what we had to show. Keep an eye out for news, I have a feeling you won’t regret it. Let us know what you would like us to talk about next!

notes.title: Devlog #8 - New skills, effect optimizations and game design!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42629950/34faf4f65fa1cec13972f5aa7e53f862fc5adbd7.png[/img]
Welcome to another [b]Soulstone Survivors devlog![/b] Today we got some cool stuff to share with you about performance but also about how we work together as a team, so if you are curious about game development this might be a cool one for you!

[h3]As we get progress further into development, we also invite you to sign up to our [url=https://gamesmithing.com/news/][b]new mailing list[/b][/url] and be among the first to find out when its released![/h3]

[h2]Reducing quantity of particle systems[/h2]

Almost every special effect you see in the game, such as explosions, trails, slashes… are made out of multiple particle systems. We can create really cool visual effects with them, however they can really become a hit to performance.

Fellipe, one of our programmers has come up with a cool solution: normally if you want to play the same effect in two different positions, you will have two separate particle effects, one in each position, doing their own thing. However, [b]there is a way that we can essentially “play” just one effect, in two (or many) different positions at the same time.[/b]

When you are talking about 1 or 2 particle effects this wont make much of a difference, but when you are talking about thousands of arrows hitting enemies such as in Storm of Arrows… we can convert literally dozens of thousands of particle systems into a single one that is played thousands of times, allowing Unity to perform additional internal optimizations to their rendering and processing. [b]Check out the difference it makes with the two videos below:[/b]

[b]Before[/b]
[previewyoutube=mZlXrbOzm3s;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]After[/b]
[previewyoutube=-TugJeAsnNM;full][/previewyoutube]
With the new changes, we have one single Particle System, and every time we need to play said effect, we can do so a lot more efficiently without changing anything in the visuals of said effects.

[h2]New Projectile Type[/h2]
Juan and Lucas have been working on a new projectile type, which we are internally calling “swarming projectiles”. [b]Check out this video of the new projectile type in action![/b] The skill in the video uses placeholder visuals but you can expect it to make an appearance very soon!
[previewyoutube=et_q6V9VZIk;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]Build Tools[/h2]
If you are a game developer or just interested in [b]how the sausage gets made,[/b] this section will certainly be interesting to you.

As you may know, we currently support 3 versions of the game: [b]Full, Prologue and the Demo.[/b] For each of these versions, we currently support 3 platforms: Windows, Mac and Linux. This means that [b]we often have to make 9 builds of our project[/b] to test everything before submitting it to Steam. Each of these builds have a different set of configuration parameters. Needless to say, making  a batch of builds is not only time-consuming but also error-prone.

To solve this issue, we’ve recently developed an internal build tool to help us manage and automate this process:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42629950/cbc5bc3f51bc0ba454e0012edc151a3c0e8d08bf.png[/img]
With this tool we are now able to configure and build many builds — all 9 configurations in fact — at once, with just one click. The tool takes care of the game configuration for the given flavor, distribution channel and flags. If you are interested in more behind-the-scenes stuff, do let us know, [b]we’d love to share more of this stuff with you! [/b]
[h2]Behind the scenes of Mh’thaeus Design[/h2]
We thought it would be really cool to show the really simple sketch we made in our initial design discussion of how the Unholy Cathedral boss and fight would work. We gather the team together and we start throwing ideas out, thinking of how the arena must be shaped, how skills interact with each other, how the boss skills will interact with the different void hunters (such as the Death Knight that doesnt have dodge)… and then we start pulling back and filtering into mechanics that seem like will work well together! [b]Check out the beautiful art below by Allan, our not artist![/b] (please don’t bully us for our amazing drawing skills =P and don't mind the Portuguese!)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42629950/e138edca81b3e0c86e8cc98d5eea45c404c8d6f3.png[/img]
This was all we had for today folks! Hope you enjoyed what we had to show. Keep an eye out for news, it might be worth your while... Let us know what you would like us to talk about next!

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42629950/34faf4f65fa1cec13972f5aa7e53f862fc5adbd7.png[/img]
Welcome to [b]the sixth Soulstone Survivors devlog!![/b] You are about to witness some [b]work in progress[/b] of a new skill, performance improvements and some changes to how the crafting UI looks.

[h3]Next major update is already getting closer and closer, so we also invite you to sign up to our [url=https://gamesmithing.com/news/][b]new mailing list[/b][/url] and be among the first to find out when its released![/h3]

[h2]Performance Improvements - XP Crystals[/h2] 
Before we get to the good stuff, lets get the usual performance update out of the way. This time around we are going to be looking at [b]changes made to the XP crystals.[/b] During a match, players can sometimes accumulate many hundreds or even thousands of XP crystals laying around on the map and this can lead to significant performance degradation. 

Luckily, the [b]XP crystals have a very well defined behavior[/b] which is very [b]suitable for some pretty neat optimizations.[/b] Check out the results we got from said optimizations: 

[h3][b]Before[/b][/h3]
[previewyoutube=MKSInQXA5Cg;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3][b]After[/b][/h3]
[previewyoutube=k7FKuWT4bu8;full][/previewyoutube]
In these videos you can see me spawning [b]100k XP crystals on a 50 meter radius[/b] around the player. [b]Before the changes, my machine could barely handle it[/b], running the game at single-digit FPS whereas [b]after the changes[/b] it has no problem at all, [b]reaching over 100 FPS.[/b]

Now for the nerds in all of us, a big, but not the only reason why these crystals are so much lighter now is the rendering. Before we were using vanilla Unity rendering techniques (i.e.: mesh renderers). But now, put it a different way, we tell the GPU: “here, render 100k copies of this object”, as opposed to “render some here, some other here, another there…”. 

Now, we manually render all of the crystals using GPU instancing, which allows us to render every crystal at once, reducing the overhead. Check out these visual examples below:

[h3][b]Unity Vanilla Rendering[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42629950/d3aeb53ee91822f1459c13f28b62a780d8ec5e47.gif[/img]
[h3][b]The New Approach[/b] [/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42629950/86d5cef87c0a5bae49be50c641d0e44f9879b57c.gif[/img]
The top version is Unity’s vanilla rendering: it takes 3 draw-calls to render the crystals; where the bottom gif with the new approach only takes 1 draw-call to render all of them.

[h2]New Upcoming Skill[/h2]
We have also been [b]working on some new skills recently[/b] and our artists have been doing an awesome job on those and we often need new 3D models for them. Check out this 3D model for an upcoming new skill:
[previewyoutube=b2fISRjvexg;full][/previewyoutube]

Lucas, one of our programmers has been working on how the crafting tab currently looks, to improve its readability. Check out the screenshot below to see how that is going: 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42629950/034b36d8a0fd535d7ad3540306742a7b8d1026f2.png[/img]
And this was all we had to show for this Devlog! We have been hard at work to [b]improve performance, UI visibility and new skills.[/b] But keep an eye out for news because we have some really cool stuff coming... Let us know what you would like us to talk about next!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42629950/0613ae8b16cc071c726ac24a6c6e0f9156b2c8a2.gif[/img]
